content_preview.title: UK Competition Watchdog Opens Antitrust Investigation Into Dassault Systèmes Over SolidWorks Software Supply
content_preview.summary: The CMA is investigating Dassault Systemes UK, Solid Solutions Management, and Visiativ Solutions over suspected anti-competitive conduct in SolidWorks software supply.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

The UK's Competition and Markets Authority has opened a formal antitrust investigation into the supply of SolidWorks computer-aided design and engineering software, targeting the UK arm of French software group Dassault Systèmes and two of its resellers. According to the [CMA's official case page](https://www.gov.uk/cma-cases/suspected-anti-competitive-conduct-in-relation-to-the-supply-of-solidworks-computer-aided-design-and-computer-aided-engineering-software-and-related-products-a...

The article correctly distinguishes the accented 'Dassault Systèmes' (parent group) from the unaccented registered company name 'Dassault Systemes UK Limited' used by the CMA and DEVELOP3D — matches source usage exactly in both cases.

Read the full extracted text. (2) source-1.html.gz (develop3d.com, HTTP 200): recomputed sha256 matches manifest exactly (742ea8155cd3c33d657e6ff0daa37a719c4e56bf92a12f3f0cd853a610c5b0ce). Read the full extracted text.
